verdict.rationale: A community user reports using mise's own monorepo tasks feature to run shared tasks across a mixed Rust/Svelte/Terraform monorepo, and another uses mise for a multi-service monorepo. This points to mise's own task runner working across workspace packages. No first-party doc shows filtering tasks or installs to a chosen subset of packages, or selecting only change-affected packages; `mise watch` rebuilds on file changes, which is a different feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented package-subset filtering for tasks and installs, affected-by-change selection, first-party monorepo docs, hands-on corroboration of filtering.
